A '''holiday''' was created by the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] to commemorate the arrival of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The holiday featured a [[Parade/Legends|parade]] with costumed [[Jester (occupation)/Legends|jesters]].
